name: what_should_i_know
description: Pre-task intelligence briefing. Given a task description and optional file paths, returns filtered advisories (security alerts, breaking changes), active decision windows, signal chains, relevant past decisions/memories, a delegation assessment (level: safe_to_delegate | review_needed | human_only | unknown) and scan_status (ready | unavailable | disabled). The briefing waits (bounded) for the live vulnerability scan; when no scan is available the level is "unknown" — treat the task as unreviewed, never as safe. safe_to_delegate is only emitted over a ready scan. Call this before starting any non-trivial task to get caught up on what matters. If the task involves upgrading, adding, or auditing dependencies, follow with upgrade_planner for the ranked plan.

task.description: Description of what you are about to work on

files.description: File paths involved in the task (optional). Improves relevance filtering.
